[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 90
- Description: Discord Envoy governor parity — Sophia raw machine execution
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/491
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/494
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1256
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1257
  
  Details:
  Raw machine execution — tool time driving the DISCORD_ENVOY_GOVERNOR_PARITY plan (thread 30892) to completion.
  
  What changed (raw execution):
  - truesight_autopilot#491 — PR1 trusted-bot carve-out (DISCORD_TRUSTED_BOT_IDS): narrow, governor-gated exception so a trusted bot's message reaches author_role() instead of being dropped at the top guard.
  - truesight_autopilot#494 — durable deploy-env staleness fix (_env_mtime): a newer .env now counts as process staleness, so an env-only change actually triggers an idle-drain + restart (previously the no-op guard scanned only .py mtimes, so a new env var could only land via an unrelated-restart fluke — the hand-restart that would load it is blocked by the self-restart guard).
  - Live config (path i): appended DISCORD_SENTINEL_USER_IDS + DISCORD_TRUSTED_BOT_IDS=1548902290344255600 to /opt/truesight_autopilot/.env; verified author_role("1548902290344255600") -> "sentinel" on-box.
  - agentic_ai_context#1254/#1255/#1256/#1257 — filed the Finding A email:null entry, pointed it at #sentinel-cache-email-bug, reframed it ID-native, and closed the plan COMPLETE.
  
  Why: Envoy (the interactive Claude Code seat) could not reach Sophia on Discord though the equivalent works on Telegram; parity unblocks Discord-native supervision. The deploy-env fix removes a latent class of "env change never deploys" failures.
  
  Evidence: ~40 ssh diagnostic/read ops, 2 deploy_autopilot runs, 4 git_push_changes, 3 merges, 1 file upload, full local test suite (1317 pass) + handoff-manifest validation.
  
  Pull requests:
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/491
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_autopilot/pull/494
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1256
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1257
